title: What a machine means by mood
thesis: Mood is on every metadata spec sheet now, and the word covers very different things. A tag on a title guessed from its synopsis is not emotion read from picture and sound, scene by scene, and checked against how people watch. Buyers deserve a way to tell them apart.
whyNow: ThinkAnalytics, ContentWise, Bitmovin, PA TV Metadata and Eon Media all sell mood or emotion attributes in 2026. A spec sheet can't show the difference. Generic language models also invent metadata: in Gracenote's own test an ungrounded model made up every attribute for 506 of 2,600 titles.
